text:
Northwind Regional will open a hub at Castellane Airfield on 3 March, adding 12 routes and three based aircraft in its first phase, the airline said Tuesday. The carrier expects to carry 680,000 passengers a year through Castellane by 2027, supported by 180 new jobs across ground handling, maintenance and scheduling.

The hub deal follows a 14-year operating agreement with airfield owner Valecrest Aviation Authority and includes a new domestic lounge, faster turnaround bays and expanded cargo space. Northwind said average fares on its core routes will fall 8% from launch levels.

For the sector, the move intensifies competition among mid-market carriers serving inland hubs and may pressure smaller regional operators to match Northwind’s frequency and pricing.
